entries.source: Staatsarchiv Ludwigsburg B 207 U 624 (deed; catalogue description); JL 425 Bd 26 Qu. 153 (Sammlung Breitenbach, later catalogue cross-reference)
entries.german: Burkard von Bach und seine Frau Anna Marschalk verkaufen an Konrad Schleicher, Bürger zu Ulm, ihre Güter und Leute zu Bollingen um 1.030 Gulden rheinisch. / 1436 Januar 12 (Donnerstag nach Obristentag)
entries.english: Burkard von Bach and his wife Anna Marschalk sell their properties and dependants at Bollingen to Konrad Schleicher, a citizen of Ulm, for 1,030 Rhenish guilders. / 12 January 1436 (Thursday after Epiphany)

facts.content: jointly sold properties and dependants at Bollingen with Burkard von Bach to Konrad Schleicher for 1,030 Rhenish guilders.
